output.content: I am checking the deployment pipeline for the new feature flags. The observability logs are currently done by hand. I pull the raw output from the staging environment and copy it into the shared spreadsheet before the morning review. There is no automated script running this step yet. I have to watch the timestamps manually to catch any drift in the model serving latency. It takes about forty minutes every Tuesday and Thursday. I am just noting how the process goes at the moment so we have a clear picture of where the manual effort sits.
